posts.text: Day 1: VBC covered the Kessa–North highway opening; Kito TV aired the first debate. Both are worth checking against the primary sources, not just summaries. Debate transcripts and the official costings are public, so read them yourself before forming a view. #VeloriaVotes

Took a fare up to the new Kessa–North highway this morning. Smooth as butter, no potholes, and my fuel bill is already feeling lighter. Good start, Ostrand. Let's see if the rest of the roads keep up 🚕
Two weeks out and everyone's already citing 'organisers say' crowd counts. Read the debate transcript yourself before you decide who costed their promises.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it 'a new era.' Arden promises 200k jobs and gets asked how he'll pay for them. Two weeks out and I still have no idea what either of them would actually do. Wake me up when someone shows receipts.
Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway and calls it prosperity. Meanwhile my fertiliser bill went up again this month. Show me the receipts, not the speech. #VeloriaVotes

Long shift, but the debate got me thinking about the wards. Both candidates promised jobs and prosperity. I want to hear what they'll actually do about nurse staffing and the 40 vacant beds on my floor. Costings matter.

Watched the debate. Ostrand on inflation: fair to note it's come down from the peak, but she skated past the real question on the cost of living. Arden's 200,000 jobs figure needs a costing before I believe it. Neither answered the moderators properly. Show me the numbers from both sides.

Saw the Kessa–North highway opening on VBC. Roads like that mean my delivery trucks stop getting stuck. Good sign. Still want to hear both candidates answer the costings question properly. Measure twice, cut once. #Veloria

Day 2 and the roads are already smoother. Kessa-North is a dream, and my fuel bill noticed. Plenty of you want receipts on the promises. Fair. Roads are one receipt I can actually feel 🚕 #VeloriaVotes
Day 2 and I'm still at 'vibes only' on both Ostrand and Arden. Neither has explained how they'd pay for their promises. Costings or it didn't happen, honestly. #VeloriaVotes

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But the same check flags a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Both things can be true. Read the costing yourself before you pick a side.
Fuel up 40% under Ostrand is the number that matters to me. Costs hit my fertiliser every month. Still waiting on the receipts from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 days out. Got a 'OFFICIAL LETTER' forward saying 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before anyone panics or shares: check the IECV site or call the commission. Day 6. A WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone forwards it: check the IECV website or VeloResults for the official notice, and ask whether anyone's seen the letter itself. Don't pass it along unverified. Those of us up north need the real info. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6: Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town name is going round. Fair to say it's a verbal slip, but it tells us nothing about her platform. Same rule as always: check the original full clip before you share a 10-second cut. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand fluffing a town name, team says 'slip of the tongue' lol. Funny, sure. But a gaffe isn't a policy. Still want the nurse staffing numbers from BOTH sides before I pick. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6. Kito's clip of Ostrand mangling a town's name is being called 'a slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, we all stumble over place names. But it's a 10-second clip and it's not a policy. Let's keep it in proportion and get back to the costings. #VeloriaVotes

Day 6, 7 out. A forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels, check the IECV site or call the commission directly. Forwards aren't notices. Also still waiting on nurse staffing costings from both sides. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Voted? Check the IECV site for official notices and VeloResults for scanned forms, not forwards. Ignore voice notes telling you to stay home. Go vote. #VeloriaVotes

Day 8, polls open. Some ID kits failed up north and the commission switched to the printed register, which the law allows. Go vote. Check the IECV site and VeloResults for anything official, and ignore the 'pre-stuffed boxes' WhatsApp photo until someone shows where it came from. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito's court order gives both sides supervised access to the servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run. Whatever it shows, I'll take that over any TV tally or 'FINAL' graphic. Go to the courts, not the comments. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC's 'riot' footage is from Kessa, but the clip is dated and the tyres are the only thing I can confirm. Kito reports the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs for both sides. That's the real story. Check the source before sharing either. #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. VBC has footage of 'riots' in Kessa, Kito says the court is ordering server and log access for both sides. Two stories, neither proves the count. Let the supervised access happen and see what the logs show. Still not doing the vibes thing. 🚕 #VeloriaVotes

Day 12. Kito reports the Civic Front petition and a Supreme Court order for supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. VBC's riot footage is a separate question. Good. A margin of 2.7 points is exactly where a server audit matters. Let the logs speak, and check them against the scanned forms.

Day 12. Kito says the court ordered the commission to open its servers and logs to both sides. Good. Whatever the audit finds, let it be checked in the open. Keep the scanned forms and the courts in view, not the riot footage or the press releases. Respect the process, and let's see the facts. #VeloriaVotes
